about: The Epistle of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity, Romans 11:33–36. The Apostle praises the unsearchable wisdom of God, from whom, through whom, and in whom are all things.

seg.tr: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are His judgments, and how unsearchable His ways!
For who has known the mind of the Lord?
Or who has been His counselor?
Or who has first given to Him, and it will be repaid to him?
For from Him, and through Him, and in Him are all things: to Him be glory forever. Amen.
